request: Build a web text editor in a single HTML file. It manages multiple document tabs that can be created, switched, and closed, every keystroke updates the character and line counts, Ctrl-S and Ctrl-F shortcuts work, a find panel supports forward and backward search with a highlighted selection, single and replace-all substitute with an escaped search term, all documents autosave to localStorage after typing pauses, and a status bar shows the active document name and byte totals.

intent.goal: build a web text editor in a single html file.

planFiles.summary: Nano Web Editor HTML, CSS, and JavaScript in one file
